This post was made by a bot. Please send any suggestions, questions, or corrections to be made to /u/ShinsekaiYori.

The first thing I want to touch on in this episode is how well they used sound, or more specifically the lack there of. Not having background music in certain scenes just makes them feel so much more intense. You really get to feel the taste of the situation when the suspense hangs heavy the air like that. It is a great way to convey how the characters are feeling.

Moving on. Prince Gadevi's champion, Bahadur, gave of the same feeling as a boss character. I felt exactly like I did on my first Dark Souls playthrough. Stepping into the arena and seeing an impressive opponent, both bigger and stronger than myself, come forth to end me then and there. His strength breaks logic. It almost felt like we were watching an UFC fighter or bodybuilder from the eyes of a child. Perhaps we're looking at him from the eyes of Arslan?

The duel itself was pretty realistic, like Daryun's sword breaking from blocking hits straight on with the blunt of his sword. Just like in real life; unless you block at an angle and redirect the blows, your sword will break from the force laid upon it. Swords are not made to be blocked with. At most you would parry, but even that is unfavourable in most cases and avoided if possible.

Daryun makes alot of mistakes in this duel. You do not block hits straight on with the shield, just like with a sword you would redirect the hits. He also doesn't use optimal movements, perhaps because he mainly fight on horseback and favour the spear over sword and shield, or maybe it is because of the overwhelming strength of the opponent.

After the fight everything happened as I, and probably most people, suspected. Although it was a nice touch that Jaswant showed up in the perfect moment, if Arslan ever wielded a sword in situations like this he wouldn't need to be saved in the first place.

Lastly, Daryun getting the title of "Sher Senani" (Fierce Tiger General) really hit home with me. Getting recognition of that level from the enemy soldiers will only help Arslan later in his quest and it will truly inspire morale when Daryun and the Shindran soldiers fight together in the future.

Overall I'd say this was another good episode in this already very good show.
